parsed.post: The attempt to increase DEPTH to 8 or optimize the current configuration resulted in a regression (0.871 vs 0.848). The model likely hit an instability or the current LR/Batch Size combo is suboptimal for depth 8. Reverting to commit 36591a9. Next, I'll try reducing the learning rate to stabilize the deeper model.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.02 to 0.015 to stabilize the training of the depth 8 architecture and prevent the divergence seen in the last run.
